model_origin: frozen R6; trained on PC request RTTs; weights and normalization unchanged
window: 5 non-overlapping paired snapshot generations; no artificial labels or register values
cadence: 3s after previous snapshot completes, delayed by explicit manual jobs; discard window on missing generation or interval >2*configured_period+2000ms
per_bus_status: ok only if whole 32-register snapshot validates
unknown_errors: UDP missing, invalid raw payload/CRC, counter reset, extra sender, wrong identity: reset feature window, no physical-fault label inferred
transaction_peak: maximum across attempted transactions in the snapshot, including failed last transaction; not full snapshot duration
local_rtt: CLOCK_MONOTONIC at web worker immediately before UDP request to validation completion; includes local IPC and gateway handling; excludes PC Ethernet
gateway_rtt: existing gateway application request/reply RTT; excludes web-local IPC; not pure forwarding latency
inference: one 16-feature request per 5 accepted snapshots, independent thread, private loopback UDP16002, strict Alnpu
archive: NPU result history last32, source samples and exact numeric request/reply included in existing AES256-GCM snapshot stream; no NPU plaintext evidence copied to SD
scope: functional integration and numeric consistency only until new domain fault stages are measured

presentation_policy.transition: Within 5 accepted samples, any bus has both available (status=ok) and unavailable (timeout/cooldown) samples. Derived independently of prediction.
presentation_policy.stable: Availability of each bus is constant across all 5 samples; timeout/cooldown changes alone do not count as transition.
presentation_policy.display: Transition primary state abstains as switching; original prediction, clipping count, numeric status and raw reply remain visible/archived. Stable predictions remain experimental.
